continuity: Jin Taekyung defeated Chulwoo after the duel appeared to have ended, overpowering his grip and knocking him unconscious with a punch to the temple.
The Quest There Is a Man Who Loved You So Much was completed, granting large EXP and Fame rewards and causing two level-ups; Taekyung's Level is now 73.

Taekyung stated that his Strength stat exceeds 300 and that he was already stronger than Chulwoo before allocating his recent stat points; his strength and speed surpassed Chulwoo's after the allocation.
Cheongpung assessed that Taekyung's victory came from speed rather than a supreme martial art and said Taekyung had read and countered Crouching Tiger Fist after only two days.
Baek Museong apologized to Jin Wikyung for belittling Taekyung and acknowledged that he and Chulwoo had learned a great deal from the duel.
Four Zhongnan Sect visitors arrived at the Jin Family gate, led by the Roaring Fury Swordsman, and demanded immediate guidance to Jin Taekyung and Cheongpung.
plot: Jin Taekyung evaded Chulwoo's Crouching Tiger Fist through overwhelming speed, resisted Chulwoo's attempt to throw him, and knocked him unconscious with a punch to the temple. The duel ended with Taekyung's victory, completing the Quest There Is a Man Who Loved You So Much and granting large EXP and Fame rewards plus two level-ups.

Baek Museong acknowledged Taekyung's exceptional martial talent, apologized to Jin Wikyung for his earlier rudeness, and accepted that he and Chulwoo had learned from the duel. At the Jin Family gate, Hyuk Mujin and a low-ranking martial artist heard the celebration before four Zhongnan Sect visitors arrived; their leader identified himself as the Roaring Fury Swordsman and demanded to be taken to Jin Taekyung and Cheongpung.
translation_decisions: Render 화산제일의 기재 as “Huashan’s greatest prodigy.”
Render 철하다. 추우야 as “Chulthetic, Pawoo,” preserving Taekyung’s sound-swapping mangling of “Pathetic, Chulwoo.”

active_continuity: Jeok Cheongang entrusted Jin Taekyung with the Flame Divine Palm manual and the Unnamed Sword forged from Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron.
Jin Wikyung ordered Taekyung, Hyuk Mujin, and Cheongpung to keep the Fire King's entrusted items and all related information secret because they can awaken Greed and drive people mad.
Three Dark Heaven remnants survived interrogation under powerful restrictions; Wipeng was ordered to keep them alive as the Jin Family's only physical evidence.
Jin Wikyung suspects Dark Heaven's attack on Shanxi Province was only the beginning and considers the Jin Family's victory suspiciously easy.
Jin Wikyung is using the grand banquet to draw loyalty and gifts from former neutrals.
Lee Seowol and the Mount Heng Sword Sect swore loyalty to the Jin Family of Taiyuan on New Year's Day, and the Jin Family accepted the sect as its vassal.
Chulwoo is twenty-five, has fallen intensely in love with Lee Seowol, and challenged Taekyung after seeing him interact with Seowol.
Taekyung has unlocked access to Sound Transmission through reaching the Peak realm but has not yet learned to use it without practice.
Taekyung's current Strength exceeds 300, and he has allocated twenty stat points to Strength and fifty to Agility.
Jin Taekyung defeated Chulwoo in the banquet duel after evading Crouching Tiger Fist, resisting Chulwoo's strength, and knocking him unconscious.
The Quest There Is a Man Who Loved You So Much was completed, granting large EXP and Fame rewards and two level-ups; Taekyung is now Level 73.
Cheongpung says Taekyung's victory relied on extraordinary speed and that Taekyung read and countered Crouching Tiger Fist after two days.
Baek Museong apologized to Jin Wikyung for his earlier rudeness and acknowledged learning from Taekyung and Chulwoo's duel.
Four Zhongnan Sect visitors arrived at the Jin Family gate, led by the Roaring Fury Swordsman, seeking Jin Taekyung and Cheongpung.

What do the four Zhongnan Sect visitors want from Jin Taekyung and Cheongpung?
